purpose: Discovery evidence ledger for UI and capability exploration engine; declarations never become launchable routes automatically.

productionCatalog.rule: Only screenshot-confirmed L0/L5 atomic pages may be promoted; L1-L4 remains candidate.

evidenceLevels.name: manual-confirmed
evidenceLevels.proves: Human confirmed target page on current device/version

evidenceLevels.name: shortcut-declaration
evidenceLevels.proves: Shortcut id and parameter shape is declared

verificationPolicy.aaStart: force-stop -> single Want -> foreground ability -> uitest dumpLayout or manual screenshot; EntryAbility/home is not target evidence.
verificationPolicy.rea: Analyze supplied HAP/binary; retain Evidence ID, SHA-256, candidate route, and unknowns; never auto-promote strings.
verificationPolicy.uiTest: Test-only adapter for our HAP or controlled verification; do not inject/click inside third-party apps.
verificationPolicy.failure: Record rejected/unavailable with reason; never fallback to app home or try a second route.

openUnknowns: Shortcut parameter acceptance and login/risk-control preconditions are unknown.
Current device canOpenLink result is unknown for every declaration in this ledger.
aa start success can still land on EntryAbility/home; target page confirmation is incomplete.
REA has not been run against user-supplied third-party HAP/binary artifacts in this workspace.
UI test extension APIs are test-only and do not establish production permissions or hidden entry points.
Apps without declaration hints may still expose undocumented or version-specific routes.
